title: 第168章 智斗巨龙贪嘴错失第167章 圣女红莲
content_zh:
一只漆黑的蜣螂迎着月色，飞速的穿行于龙州的丛林之中。
据记忆中道宗古籍的记载，每到夜晚，龙族的警觉以及活动性便会下降，正是寻找目标的好时候。
龙族性惰，这与他们极高的天赋密不可分。
寻常龙族成年便可至元婴，凭借着龙族极高的自身天赋，在化神无法对元婴动手的三千州，他们只要成年，便可安稳欢乐度过一生。
在没有生存压力的情况下，大部分龙族都会选择躺平，积极向上、奋力修炼的龙，少之又少。
一股异常强大的气息突然出现在茅不易的神识探查之中，茅不易迅速收回神识，运转《苟》字诀，收敛自身全部气息。
一只与普通蜣螂并未两样的漆黑蜣螂顺着夜间的暖风，缓缓飞向前方，一只金色巨龙出现在茅不易的眼中。
茅不易悄悄飞到巨龙的面前，正准备施展《御》字诀。
“阿秋！”
巨龙似是感到微小的异物萦绕鼻尖，猛地打了个喷嚏，恐怖的气浪，夹杂着些许湿润的液体，瞬间便将茅不易那微小的身形吹飞。
茅不易停稳身形，抖了抖身躯，将那恶心、粘稠的液体抖落，目光坚定的朝着巨龙飞去。
“这巨龙是不是从来没刷过牙！”
“恶心死我了！这简直比灵球还臭！”
“幸亏本虫上一世饱经磨练，要不这一喷嚏就能把本虫臭晕过去。”
茅不易对那鼻涕心有余悸，出于谨慎考虑，这次茅不易决定换一个方向靠近。
茅不易缓缓飞向巨龙的侧翼，想要停靠在他那双巨大的双翼之上。
但巨龙的感知属实灵敏，哪怕再微小的波动都能引起巨龙的本能反应。
巨龙似是感到了身侧的瘙痒，未等茅不易停稳脚步便微微震动双翼，一股巨风瞬间将茅不易卷飞出去。
数百米外，茅不易停稳身形，再度看向了巨龙的位置。
空空如也。

“龙呢！”
“玩我呢！”
茅不易前肢紧紧收紧，心有不甘的再度朝着巨龙的方才的方向飞去。
而那头巨龙，正眯着双眼，悠闲的朝着东方飞去，只是他的心有略有疑惑。
龙族至高无上，气息威压万灵，寻常蚊虫某说袭扰，连靠近都不曾有过。
今日真是奇怪！
“哎，纯血龙族本就稀少无比，不能展露神识，不可暴露气息，这让我如何探寻！”
正当茅不易踌躇之时，一股熟悉且恶心的气温顺着鼻孔，直至天灵盖。
“呕！”
茅不易忍不住在心中干呕了一下。
“对了，这龙族性惰，不爱好卫生，我如今化为蜣螂，对气味及其敏感，可以循着这气味寻找龙族！”
茅不易循着气味，朝着巨龙离开方向疾驰而去。
“呕！”
“呕！”
只是这一路不断的干呕，属实折磨！
终于在一山峦重叠之处，那抹金色再度出现，茅不易复眼在洁白的月光下不断闪烁。
“吸取教训，不能从前方侧方靠近！”
这一次茅不易悄悄飞到了巨龙的后方。
巨龙虽然已经睡着，但他那粗壮、灵活的尾巴仿佛有着独立的思考一般，不断的左右挥舞。
这让茅不易的靠近变得极为困难。

茅不易左躲，右闪，好不容易距离巨龙的后背还剩十米不到，一股巨力猛地从茅不易右方传来，瞬间便将茅不易击飞出去，死死嵌在了山体之中。
“再来！”
content_en:
A dark dung beetle faced the moonlight and quickly walked through the jungle of Longzhou.
According to the records in ancient Dao Zong books from my memory, the vigilance and activity of the dragons will decrease every night, which is a good time to find targets.
Dragons are sexually lazy, which is inseparable from their extremely high talents.
Ordinary dragons can reach Yuanying when they reach adulthood. With the extremely high talents of the dragons, in the Three Thousand States where the gods cannot take action on Yuanying, as long as they reach adulthood, they can live a stable and happy life.
When there is no pressure to survive, most dragons will choose to lie down. There are very few dragons who are positive and work hard to practice.
An unusually powerful aura suddenly appeared in Mao Buyi's spiritual consciousness exploration. Mao Buyi quickly withdrew his spiritual consciousness, ran the "Gou" formula, and restrained all his aura.
A pitch-black dung beetle, no different from an ordinary dung beetle, slowly flew forward along the warm night wind, and a giant golden dragon appeared in Mao Buyi's eyes.
Mao Buyi quietly flew in front of the giant dragon and was about to use the "Yu" technique.
"Aqiu!"
The giant dragon seemed to feel a tiny foreign object lingering on the tip of its nose, and sneezed suddenly. The terrifying air wave, mixed with a little moist liquid, instantly blew Mao Buyi's tiny figure away.
Mao Buyi stopped, shook his body, shook off the disgusting, viscous liquid, and flew towards the dragon with a firm gaze.
"Has this dragon never brushed his teeth?"
"It disgusts me to death! This smells worse than the spirit ball!"
"Fortunately, I have gone through a lot of training in my previous life, otherwise this sneeze would have knocked me out."
Mao Buyi had lingering fears about the snot. Out of caution, Mao Buyi decided to approach from another direction this time.
Mao Buyi slowly flew towards the dragon's flanks, wanting to land on his huge wings.
But the dragon's perception is really sensitive, and even the smallest fluctuations can cause the dragon's instinctive reaction.
The giant dragon seemed to feel itching on its side. Before Mao Buyi could stop, it vibrated its wings slightly, and a huge wind instantly swept Mao Buyi away.
Several hundred meters away, Mao Buyi stopped and looked at the dragon's position again.
Empty.
"Where's the dragon!"
"Playing with me!"
Mao Buyi tightened his forelimbs tightly and unwillingly flew towards the dragon's direction again.
And the giant dragon was squinting its eyes and flying leisurely towards the east, but he was slightly confused.
The Dragon Clan is supreme, and its aura is overwhelming to all spirits. Ordinary mosquitoes are said to harass them, and they have never even come close.
What a strange day today!
"Hey, pure-blood dragons are extremely rare. They can't show their consciousness or reveal their aura. How can I explore this!"
Just when Mao Buyi was hesitating, a familiar and disgusting temperature flowed down his nostrils and reached Tianling Gai.
"Ugh!"
Mao Buyi couldn't help but retched in his heart.
"By the way, this dragon is lazy and doesn't like hygiene. Now I've turned into a dung beetle and I'm extremely sensitive to smells. I can follow this smell to find the dragon!"
Mao Buyi followed the smell and galloped towards the direction where the giant dragon left.
"Ugh!"
"Ugh!"
But the constant retching along the way was really torture!
Finally, where the mountains overlapped, that golden touch appeared again, and Mao Buyi's compound eyes kept flashing under the white moonlight.
"Learn your lesson, don't approach from the front or the side!"
This time Mao Buyi quietly flew behind the dragon.
Although the dragon was already asleep, his thick and flexible tail seemed to be thinking independently, waving left and right.
This made it extremely difficult for Mao Buyi to get close.
Mao Buyi dodged to the left, dodged to the right, and finally was less than ten meters away from the dragon's back. A huge force suddenly came from the right of Mao Buyi, and instantly knocked Mao Buyi away, and was embedded in the mountain.
"Come again!"
